fact: Angola's SEPE e-services portal lists a free online service, 'Consulta de NIF', to consult the information associated with a person's NIF.
Secretary of State Osvaldo Amaro said synchronisation with the tax administration (AGT) lets the Bilhete de Identidade number correspond to the taxpayer number (NIF).
CIAT authors say SIGT covers taxpayer registration, and AGT offers a Tax Identification Number Lookup tool.
